description: A genital or perianal infection caused by herpes simplex virus.
risk_factors: Sexual contact with an infected partner

appearance.general: Grouped vesicles or shallow painful ulcers on genital or perianal skin or mucosa.

warning_signs: Severe pain, urinary retention, pregnancy, neurological symptoms, or extensive lesions requires medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss sexual exposure, previous episodes, pregnancy if relevant, and testing options.
